metadata.title: Tiling 3D by Translates of a Single Polycube is Undecidable
metadata.abstract: We prove co-RE-completeness, and thus undecidability, of the following problem: given a single (connected) polycube, decide whether it tiles 3D Euclidean space by translations. We reduce from Wang tiling using the decorated two-prime Sudoku construction of Greenfeld and Tao and a cyclic encoding adapted from OpenAI's 3D aperiodic tile, and apply a reduction of Kim to make the prototile connected (via faces). Dimension three is optimal: translational monotiling is known to be decidable in $\mathbb{Z}^2$ and for a single (possibly disconnected) polyomino in $\mathbb{R}^2$.

analysis.progressType: 证明单个连通三维 polycube 仅靠平移铺满空间的判定问题为 co-RE 完全，因而不可判定。
analysis.workSummary: 通过 Wang 铺砌、双素数 Sudoku 编码、周期商上的多瓷砖合并及连通化归约，证明单个连通三维 polycube 仅靠平移铺满 Z³ 或 R³ 的判定为 co-RE 完全；文中列出 Lean 的连通性、铺砌定义及四个主定理接口。
analysis.breakthrough: 把三维平移铺砌不可判定性推进到单个连通瓷砖。
analysis.limitations: 本文是证明概要，完整细节在外部 Lean 仓库及 LLM 技术稿；此次已读声明和接口，未独立运行 Lean 或核验完整形式化依赖。
